notes: The axis pointer's own highlight / downplay batches (notBlur) are not recorded.
Pointer steps: zrender Handler mousemove / mousedown + mouseup + click / mouseout from outside; each 10 ms after the last.
A frame after every step; a `flush` case's frames are zrender's own loop (animation.update, then _flush(false)) and record rendered / finished.

cases.note: legendScroll: one event, each item a copy; escapeConnect in the head
a batch that is no list maps to no items: an event with an empty batch
a silent batch publishes nothing
selectDataRange on a continuous visualMap: the action returns nothing, each item a copy
the legacy pieToggleSelect: its event, then the toggleSelect each item dispatched waits and runs after
geoToggleSelect: each item's event is the action's result
geoRoam: the update is none, the event per item
sunburstRootToNode: updateView once, each item a copy
treemapRootToNode: each item a copy
graphRoam on a graph with no layout
dragNode on a sankey: update once, each item a copy
takeGlobalCursor: each item a copy; the update reads the outer payload (an item brushOption alone would leave it none)
brush: updateVisual once, each item a copy; the brushSelect its update dispatched comes after
brushEnd: no update, each item a copy
timelineChange: the action's results, the update once
timelinePlayChange: each item a copy
axisAreaSelect on two parallel axes: each item a copy
parallelAxisExpand: each item a copy
expandAxisBreak (a refined event): the non-refined event goes to connect only; one axisbreakchanged with every item's breaks
showTip (tooltip:manuallyShowTip per item): one showtip event; the updateAxisPointer each item dispatched waits
showTip under an item trigger: each item shows its element
hideTip: one hidetip event; the hideTip each _hide dispatched waits
updateAxisPointer (an update of its own per item): its event the outputPayloads; the showTips wait
pieToggleSelect alone: its event, its update, then the toggleSelect it dispatched (pending) with selectchanged
a handler of the first hidetip dispatches a legendToggleSelect: it runs at once and its own flush takes the hideTip the outer one left waiting, before its updated
a silent hideTip: nothing published, the pending hideTip either
a handler of legendselectchanged dispatches a highlight: it runs at once, between the outer event and its updated
zrender flushes when something was marked: a hover that changes a state, a tooltip box that moves; nothing changed, nothing flushed

a flush inside the handler of pietoggleselect, while the toggleSelect it dispatched still waits: rendered, no finished (bindRenderedEvent: _pendingActions not empty); the step's own frame after the flush: both
no tooltip: a move inside the same bar marks nothing
